g.text: FlowState: Autonomous ML Research Architecture v3
Integrity-Gated Research Loop • Research Knowledge MCP Gateway • Multi-Tier Filter-Only Proxy • Transactional Rollback • All Design Decisions [DD-1 to DD-9] Labeled
🗄️ DATA, ARTIFACT & PROVENANCE LAYER (KuaiRand-Pure Splits & Scientific Memory)
• Features: user_id, video_id, static user/video features
• Aux Signals: is_click, is_like, is_follow, play_time_ms
🔒 Fit preprocessors on train only; zero leakage
• Immutable Parquet artifact keyed by video_id
🎯 Source of Truth for decisions & ε=0.002
Records contracts, diffs, metric receipts, failures
• Hardware Meters: LLM tokens, GPU-hrs, peak RAM
Immutable DAG: Retains accepted and rejected runs
❌ ZERO access, inspection, or tuning during dev
• Used exactly 1x by Finalizer for submission export
• IPS Diagnostics: Inverse propensity score weights
• Tests if ranking gains hold on unbiased traffic
🧠 LLM REASONING & RESEARCH KNOWLEDGE MCP LAYER
🌐 Research Knowledge MCP Gateway [OPTIONAL / LITERATURE-TIER EVIDENCE]
• Pinned commit SHA, license & file hash
Matches exact terms: GAUC, nDCG, BPR
• License gate: Enforces open license (MIT, Apache)
• Content Hasher: sha256 addressing for cache keys
Security: External text cannot grant agent capabilities
Authority: Literature tier (Rank 6, below measured runs)
⚡ [DD-2] Triple Caps: API requests / docs / tokens
Rate Limiter: Exponential backoff on 429 / outages
Read-Only MCP Tool Surface (Exposed to Scientist & Coder)
• Pinned repo commit SHA + file tree
• Diagnostics Profile (within-user variance, sequence lengths, drift)
• Run Ledger History & Scoped Claims • Remaining Budget
1. Ranking Loss: Pairwise BPR / Listwise Plackett-Luce (Objective alignment)
2. Sequence Modeling: DIN / SIM / SASRec user interest extractors
3. Multi-Task Learning (MTL): MMoE / PLE using is_click, is_like, play_time
4. Censored Watch Time: CWM duration survival loss for play_time_ms
⚠️ Dead Ends Pruned: No static 13 CWM features, no capacity scaling
Queries MCP evidence gateway before committing causal hypothesis
• 1 primary causal hypothesis & exact code/config scope
• Predicted metric movement: ΔGAUC & ΔnDCG@5 vs FM baseline
- Overfit / Underfit → Dedicated regularization / capacity branch
Guardrails: ε=0.002 convergence threshold, fallback = stable_fallback
• Pinned MCP Reference Code + Repository Source Tree
• Applies minimal code patch in isolated Git worktree
• Writes targeted unit & contract verification tests
❌ evaluate.py is LOCKED (Source of truth, immutable)
❌ Prior ledger run history is APPEND-ONLY
Semantic Bug Fixing: Fixes syntax, shapes & device errors locally
OUTPUT: Isolated Git Diff Patch & Tests
• Pinned configuration artifact with sha256 hash
Escalation target when deterministic parameter recovery is exhausted
⚙️ DETERMINISTIC INTEGRITY KERNEL & EXECUTION ENGINE (Zero LLM Tokens — Ordinary Safe Code)
IN: Raw Training Tables & Split Logs
• Interaction counts & user candidate list lengths
• Sent to Context Compiler for Scientist
Zero raw interaction rows in prompts (token efficient)
• Safety violation → Fail closed & log incident
Prevents silent data leakage between splits
Tier 1: Static, Schema & Leakage Check (Zero GPU Cost)
• AST diff guard, evaluator immutability, type assertions
Pass → Advance to Tier 2 | Fail → Return to Coder
Tier 2: Tiny Mechanical Smoke Run (100 Batches)
• Verifies tensor shapes, forward/backward pass, loss finite
Pass → Advance to Tier 3 | Fail → Fast recovery
• Evaluates convergence & regression on fixed subsample
- May REJECT: Crashes, OOMs, NaN loss, severe regression
- MUST NOT promote final model or advance N=3 counter
- Rejected proxy runs logged as proxy/non_comparable
Tier 4: Full Train Split & Official Validation Promotion
• Evaluated by official evaluate.py on 7-day validation split
• Official baseline (FM) executed on each proxy tier as local reference
• Absolute gating prevents discarding promising noisy architectures
• Fast-rejection saves >80% of GPU compute on non-viable code
Auditable: Every proxy decision written to SQLite Run Ledger
• Approved Git Diff Patch (isolated worktree) + Config
• Full Train Split (1.14M rows) + Frozen Train Transforms
• Pinned random seeds (Baseline std σ = 0.0008 across 5 seeds)
• Atomic checkpoint writes with sha256 checksums
• Telemetry streaming: loss, learning rate, GPU RAM, throughput
• Tracks per-signal losses for auxiliary tasks (click, like, play_time)
• Measures gradient conflict against primary long_view ranking
• Invariant: Row order permutation does NOT change GAUC/nDCG
• Invariant: Shuffled labels drop metrics to chance (~0.475)
• Trapped by Auto-Recovery Controller without crashing agent loop
• Exact stacktrace & memory telemetry preserved in log
• CPU Single-Core FM Baseline runtime: ~40 seconds
Completely reproducible from seeds & pinned environment
All run outputs verified against baseline ledger
IN: Crashes, CUDA OOM, NaN Loss, Timeouts
• Do NOT erase failed experiments from Run Ledger
• Reset Git worktree & point next run to stable_fallback
• Remove failed branch from active exploration frontier
• Parameter retry cap exhausted → Escalate to Code Agent
Zero silent failures; exact error diagnosis recorded in receipt
• GAUC: Per-user AUC, positive-count weighted (63.7% active users)
• nDCG@5: Gain 2^rel − 1; all-negative users score 0.0 (in mean)
OUTPUT: Signed Metric Receipt (GAUC, nDCG@5, Primary, Hashes)
Checksum of evaluate.py verified before each run
Zero test set contamination during validation cycles
• Signed Metric Receipt (GAUC, nDCG@5, Primary Score)
• Telemetry Meters: Tokens, GPU-hours, Wall time
• Stop condition: ΔPrimary < 0.002 for 3 consecutive rounds
OR Total GPU-hours / Token Budget exhausted
Route A: Iteration Loop (If not converged)
Updates Run Ledger & sends receipt to Scientist (Step 9)
Route B: Finalize Trigger (Converged / Budget Reached)
Zero human intervention required to decide stop
• Appends run record, parameters, diff & metric receipt
• Increments cumulative LLM token & GPU counters
IN: Confirmed Validation-Best Model Checkpoint + Sealed Test Split Features
• Activated strictly after convergence (ε=0.002, N=3) or budget limit reached
• Replays clean environment & applies frozen train-fitted preprocessing to test split
• Generates final predictions for all 23,875 test users (04/29–05/08)
🔒 Sealed Test Boundary: Exactly ONE forward inference pass; zero test label reading
Submission Validation: python3 submit.py --check --split test submission.csv
Verifies: row_id integrity, user_id/video_id alignment, no NaNs/Infs, exact row count
• Cryptographic Manifest: Dataset sha256, git commit, config hash, environment receipt
• Complete SQLite Run Ledger: All experiment contracts, metrics, diff patches & recovery events
• Resource Accounting: Cumulative LLM tokens, GPU hours, wall-clock seconds, manual_interventions=0
✅ Clean-Machine Reproducibility: Fully executable on clean environment without interventions
Submitted once to organizer terminal evaluation; final artifact selection is irreversible
Diagram Legend & Design Decisions Index (Mapped to Design-Decision.md)
[DD-1] Offline Co-Occurrence (Layer 1.2) • [DD-2] Query-Hash Cache & Caps (Layer 2A.2) • [DD-3] Top-25 Local Vector Store (Layer 2A.1 & 2A.2)
[DD-4] Filter-Only Proxy (Layer 3.3) • [DD-5] Multi-Tier Pruning (Layer 3.3) • [DD-6] Transactional Rollback (Layer 3.5 & 1.4) • [DD-7] Phase-Boundary Checks (Layer 3.2)
Train data profiled → within-user variance (27.1% neg, 63.7% active) & seq lengths to Scientist
Step 2: MCP Evidence Query [OPTIONAL - DD-8, DD-3]
Scientist queries hybrid store / OpenAlex / GitHub for grounded literature & reference code
Scientist issues contract with 1 primary hypothesis, metric bounds & pre-declared handlers
Coder applies minimal patch in isolated Git worktree; AST diff guard ensures evaluator locked
Tier 1 Static → Tier 2 Smoke → Tier 3 Proxy filter-only check (fast rejection of non-viable code)
Isolated worktree training on 1.14M rows; pinned seed control; atomic checkpoint storage
Predictions evaluated strictly by evaluate.py on 7-day validation split (GAUC & nDCG@5)
Signed receipt sent to Watchdog; Run Ledger updated; checkpoint saved; token meters counted
Step 9 (If not converged): Next loop | Step 10 & 11 (Converged / Budget limit): Export package
Test Features Only (1x Final Inference Pass)
